task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write a Cirq program computing linear cross-entropy benchmarking (XEB) fidelity of random single-qubit-rotation + CZ circuits on 5 qubits, depth 12, comparing a noiseless sampler against the ideal probabilities (expected XEB ≈ 1). Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
